method_observation.observation: Treat navigational readiness as coupled but separately clocked states rather than a single approved-plan or underway flag. Passage appraisal/plan revision, chart or ENC information readiness, weather/routeing inputs, bridge-watch and handover readiness, pilot/VTS interface, position cross-checks, navigation-equipment degradation and deviation/replan status can diverge in time; collapsing them hides what the bridge could actually know and execute at a historical cutoff.

seal_effect.reason: High-importance novelty remains; major coverage gaps, negative-space review and challenger gates remain incomplete.

truth_boundary: Memory-only orientation and not navigation, safety, regulatory, pilotage, collision-avoidance, operational or legal advice; no route, waypoint, chart/ENC status, weather recommendation, watch arrangement, pilotage requirement, position, maneuver, fault, record completeness, provider capability or jurisdictional conclusion is verified.
